about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Second Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the working of Thy power increase within us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that, strengthened by the divine sacraments, we may by Thy gift be prepared to receive the things they promise. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
